items.title: US500 falls 0.08% to 7,704 on Aug 7, up 20.6% YoY
items.content: The US500 index fell to 7,704 points on August 7, 2026, losing 0.08% from the previous session. Over the past month the index climbed 2.96% and is up 20.58% versus a year ago.

items.title: Iran war live: Tehran, Oman agree on route coordinates in Hormuz Strait; ship hit in Red Sea
items.content: US-Israel war on Iran live updates: Tehran and Oman reportedly agreed on route coordinates in the Strait of Hormuz, with talks described as positive, while a ship was hit in the Red Sea. Diplomacy on reopening Hormuz continues amid resumed attacks on shipping.

items.title: US stocks hold near records Wednesday; oil prices steady
items.content: Stocks held close to their records on Wall Street on Aug 5, while oil prices held steady as investors weighed Hormuz reopening progress against continued shipping attacks.

items.title: Qatar says mediators make progress in efforts to end US-Iran conflict; ship struck in Hormuz
items.content: Qatar said mediators made progress in efforts to end the US-Iran conflict, while status of talks remained uncertain after a ship was struck in the Strait of Hormuz. Markets are watching for signs of de-escalation to reopen the strait.

items.title: S&P 500 back at record high; Dow hits 54,000
items.content: The S&P 500 closed at a record high, supported by strong corporate earnings, a rebound in tech shares and traders embracing hopes for progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz. The Dow Jones Industrial Average surpassed 54,000.

items.title: Dow led by Caterpillar +5% to record close; S&P 500 also records
items.content: The 30-stock Dow was led by a more than 5% rise in Caterpillar, surpassing its intraday record from last month. Both the S&P 500 and the Dow posted record closes, with tech jumping 4%.

items.title: Hang Seng falls 0.6% to 25,853, snapping six-session winning streak
items.content: The Hang Seng Index fell 0.6%, or 156 points, to close at 25,853 on Tuesday Aug 5, snapping six consecutive sessions of gains, as investors took profits and sentiment weakened.

items.title: Hang Seng rises 0.5% to 26,009 on renewed US-Iran diplomacy hopes
items.content: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index closed higher Monday, Aug 3, rising 124.97 points or 0.5% to 26,009.40, on renewed US-Iran diplomacy hopes.

items.title: China stocks rise as AI, chip shares rebound
items.content: Shanghai Composite closed up 0.3% at 3,822.28 while CSI 300 rose 1.3%. ChiNext jumped 5.7% and STAR 50 rose 4.1%; China's CSI Artificial Intelligence Index climbed 5.9%, a sharp rebound after the prior session's AI-driven selloff.

items.title: China stocks close down as global AI selloff hammers chip supply chain
items.content: China stocks ended lower Monday Aug 3 as a global rout in AI-related shares dragged down semiconductor stocks, while Hong Kong internet platforms bucked the trend, led by a jump in Alibaba after it released a new AI model.

items.title: US June PCE inflation cools: -0.1% MoM, annual rate 3.7% from 4.1%
items.content: US PCE price index decreased 0.1% month-over-month in June 2026 as expected, after a 0.5% rise in May. Annual PCE slowed to 3.70% in June from 4.10% in May. Core PCE also cooled, easing concerns over Fed rate path. (注：數據發布日為7月31日，屬近期宏觀背景)

items.title: Earnings calendar: 323 companies reported Thursday Aug 6; season winding down
items.content: US Q2 earnings season wrapped its heaviest week with 323 reports on Aug 6 and 74 on Aug 7. Strong results have underpinned the S&P 500's record run.
